title: Elizondo's Imminent: people with Cherokee DNA have more experiences

tellings.quote: You read Luis Elizondo's book Imminent, it's in there. He says it seems to be that people with Cherokee blood and uh DNA have more experiences

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office studying UFO reports, writes in his book Imminent that people with Cherokee blood and DNA seem to have more encounters with the phenomenon. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels "it's in there" when he talks about the book. If true, it would suggest these experiences run in some family lines.
